checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One 16:9 image with original left and renovated right
must.why: Output is a single renovated kitchen, no side-by-side, and not 16:9 (about 5:3).

must.item: Left photo retains brown cabinets, beige tiles, clutter
Right panel has white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles, uncluttered counters
must.why: Has white cabinets and subway tiles and clean counters, but counters are white, not light oak, and it is not a right panel.
Layout, camera angle, sink and corner closely match the original.

faults.what: No before/after comparison; only the renovated kitchen is shown
Countertops are white quartz rather than light oak
Stove added where original had a second sink; low resolution (640px)

summary: The output is a clean, faithful renovated kitchen, but it is a single image with no Before panel, no labels, and white rather than light oak counters.
